system.summary: The gray troll spreads diseases to those nearby.
system.description:
Trolls live a primitive and filthy life, which means that they may carry many diseases. Anyone who gets within 2 meters of a troll that carries a plague must make a situation roll with a situation value of 7 (Constitution modifiers apply). If the roll succeeds, the person is immune for a month to plagues carried by trolls. If the roll fails, the person is afflicted with one of the following effects. Roll on the table below.

1d20Effect
1-5The troll's stench permeates the victim's clothes, making the victim smell terrible.
6-9Dizziness: -1 to skill and situation values for one hour.
10-13A bad cold: -1 to skill and situation values for one day.
14-16A very bad cold and fever for 1d6 days: -2 to skill and situation values, movement reduced to 2/3.
17-18Severe redness for 1d6 days: -3 to skill and situation values. At the end, roll against situation value 7 (Constitution); on failure, the same effect lasts for an additional 1d3 days.
19-201d10+5 large boils appear. Each day 1d3 burst until all are gone; each boil deals 1d3 damage when it bursts.
